depiction.primary_object: two vertical wavy lines next to half a snowflake
depiction.composition: split symbol combining heat waves on the left and a half snowflake on the right

readings.meaning: HVAC / heating and cooling / climate control
hot and cold therapy / contrast bath

ambiguity: At small sizes, the half-snowflake can look like a tree branch or arrow pointing left into wavy water lines.
task_intents: service home HVAC heating and cooling system
install or maintain a heat pump
switch thermostat between winter and summer modes
do hot and cold contrast therapy

example_tasks.task: Vacuum the coils and drain line
Switch the Ecobee schedule from cooling over to heating mode
Rinse the dust screens on the bedroom mini-split unit
Get the Subaru climate control checked before the July road trip
Try 15 minutes of hot-cold contrast packs on my sore ankle
Ask the landlord when the building switches from chillers to steam heat
Test whether the new insulated thermos keeps soup hot and water ice-cold
Bleed the upstairs radiators and put the vinyl cover over the outside A/C condenser
Call three local contractors for quotes on replacing the oil furnace with a ducted heat pump
Take the vacuum-sealed brisket out of the deep freeze on Thursday so it thaws by Saturday

example_tasks_es: Limpiar los filtros del aire acondicionado frío-calor antes del verano
Descongelar el arcón del garaje este fin de semana

example_tasks_ru: Почистить фильтры сплит-системы перед началом сезона

context_tasks.task: Seal leaky basement ductwork with mastic tape
Add Wi-Fi sensor in the nursery for the thermostat

Put foam pipe insulation on the outdoor condensate line

near_misses.task: Buy a hot-and-cold insulated water bottle for hiking
Check the weather forecast for the weekend camping trip

Prune the dead branches off the pine tree by the driveway

reasoning: Combining vertical heat waves with a half-snowflake is the standard pictogram for HVAC climate control, heat pumps, and defrosting. It fits concrete household tasks around heating/cooling maintenance, seasonal changeovers, and thawing, while remaining visually distinct from plain thermometer or weather icons.
